args.title: Only treat a quote as field-opening at the start of a field
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

splitFields() currently enters quoted mode whenever it sees a `"` anywhere in an unquoted field, not just at the start of a field. A description like `Monitor 27" Dell U2724D` therefore opens a quoted span at the inch mark and swallows the rest of the line (including the real comma delimiters), producing a row with fewer fields than the header and the "Malformed row" error.

The fix is to only switch into quoted mode when the quote is the very first character of the current field (i.e. `current === ""` and we are not already inside a quoted field), matching standard CSV quoting rules; a quote elsewhere in an unquoted field should be copied through as an ordinary character.

splitFields() opens quoted mode on any `"` inside an unquoted field, not just one at the start of a field, so an inch mark like in `Monitor 27" Dell U2724D` swallows the rest of the line and shorts the field count, triggering the rowShape error. The fix is to only treat a quote as field-opening when it's the first character of the current field, and otherwise copy it through literally.
